_comment: Economy v1 D2 windowed shop-moment shot (NOT a canonical sweep member -- peek-style utility, excluded from ci_sweep). Loads the d2_shop fixture (Warrior L1 beside Krshia, purse = 5 gold) via title Continue. Proves BOTH halves of the shop UX in one run: (A) at 5 gold the cheapest buy (traveler_charm, 5) is affordable/ungreyed while the 15/18/24 options are greyed -- screenshot 01; (B) buy the charm (Paid 5 gold + Got item), purse -> 0; (C) re-open the stall now broke -> ALL four buy options greyed -- screenshot 03 (the greyed-while-broke proof). Windowed so the greyed dialogue options are visually inspectable.
